product_metadata.title: Dish Drying Mat Dish Mat Drying Mat for Kitchen Counter Dish Drying Pad Dish Mat Drying Kitchen Mat 2 Pack (yellow)
features: 【Package Includes】2 * drying mats. 19.3*15 Inch large size countertop drying mats can hold more kitchen wares and utensils. And it quickly absorbs water droplets for bowls, plate racks, cutlery, cups etc.

【Super Water Absorption】This product is made of microfiber material. Absorbs water up to 4 times of its own weight to keep the countertops dry. This dish drying pad is hand washable and machine washable.
【Protect Your Counters】Our drying mats protect your counters from scuffs and scratches, while keeping your kitchen utensils, especially glasswares, safe, clean and dry.
【Easy to Storage】It can be folded up and put in a drawer at any time when not in use. In addition, the hanging design makes it easy to hang and wait for natural drying.
【Quality Services】We're sure you'll love our dish drying mat, If for any reason you're not completely satisfied with this product, let us know, we are happy to help!
